attributes.name: Blessing of Kols
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any combat check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any Strength non-combat check.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Kols or Torag trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
